summary: Travere Therapeutics completed a $525.0M registered public offering of 0.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032, including $50.0M from the full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, interest payable semi-annually, and convertible at holder's option under certain stock price conditions. Joint book-running managers were J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, and Leerink Partners. Proceeds are not specified but typical offerings fund corporate purposes. Watch for potential dilution upon conversion and any impact on share price from the increased leverage.
